hero.subtitle: Check your email: it has the date, the link, and how to prepare. What you do now defines how much value we get from the session.

email.title: Check your confirmation email
email.body: You'll find the date, time (with time zone), the session link, and how to reschedule in advance. If you don't see it, check spam or promotions.

checklist.title: Before you
checklist.description: Check off each step. Showing up prepared multiplies the value of your 60 minutes.
items: I join 5 minutes early to check audio and connection
I have my CV or achievement summary ready (with numbers: impact, savings, people led)
I write 3 concrete questions about my case (target visa, timeline, investment)
I reserve a quiet space with no interruptions

session.title: What happens in your
session.kicker: Clarity before you invest in your visa

steps.label: Diagnosis
steps.body: We analyze your professional, academic, or business profile and the gap to your U.S. goal.

steps.label: Possible paths
steps.body: We identify which visa fits (EB-2 NIW or others) and what evidence you need to strengthen.

steps.label: Next steps
steps.body: You leave with a clear 90-day roadmap — no fluff, with priorities.

proof.quote: I went from not knowing where to start to a clear path for my EB-2 NIW. I left the session with concrete priorities, not a generic PDF.

cta.whatsapp: Yes, I confirm my attendance on WhatsApp
cta.whatsappMsg: Hi, I just booked my MORE session and want to confirm my attendance.
cta.whatsappHint: A short message reduces no-shows and helps us prepare better for your case.
